UI_SplitscreenFixes_Options_desc: Splitscreen layout changes. Turn one off to get the vanilla behaviour back. Bug fixes (item transfers, cars, aiming, search mode, moodles) always work.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_ownMap_tooltip: Each player opens the map on their own screen and the others keep moving. Off: one shared map over the whole window, as in vanilla. Close open maps before changing.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_flierWindow: Flier window on the player's screen
UI_SplitscreenFixes_flierWindow_tooltip: A flier or brochure is sized and kept on its player's screen and is not closed by another player's map.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_ownCrafting_tooltip: Opening a crafting window doesn't close the other players' windows; windows open on the player's screen. Off: one crafting window at a time, centred on the whole window.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_mechanicsWindow: Mechanics window on the player's screen
UI_SplitscreenFixes_mechanicsWindow_tool: The vehicle mechanics window opens on its player's screen and shrinks to fit. Off: centred on the whole window.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_contextMenus: Context menus on the player's screen
UI_SplitscreenFixes_contextMenus_tooltip: Right-click menus and submenus stay on their player's screen and scroll when they don't fit.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_dialogs_tooltip: Confirmation dialogs open in the middle of their player's screen. The gamepad answers them either way.
UI_SplitscreenFixes_ownClocks_tooltip: Each player with a watch has a clock with their own temperature and alarm in the corner of their screen. Off: one clock in the middle, as in vanilla.
